login.title: Expense reconciliation
login.subtitle: Receipts from the bexio inbox, read, sorted by payment account and matched with Revolut transactions.
login.footer: Restricted to Tekad and its accounting firm.
login.heroTitle: Every receipt read, sorted and matched.
login.heroText: Receipts dropped into the bexio inbox are read (merchant, date, amount, VAT, card), assigned to the right account — Revolut, UBS or Anthony's current account — and to the right expense type; the bexio entry is proposed, and Revolut debits without a receipt are listed.

expenses.title: Receipts
expenses.subtitle: Receipts from the bexio inbox: payment account, type, booking and matching.
expenses.unpriced_one: {{count}} receipt without a CHF amount is not counted.
expenses.unpriced_other: {{count}} receipts without a CHF amount are not counted.

expenseDetail.title: Receipt
expenseDetail.notExtracted: Receipt not read yet: "Read again" reads it now.
expenseDetail.overridesHint: Empty: the proposal (in grey) — the type's account debited, the payment account credited, the type's VAT code.

missing.paymentAccount: No payment account chosen (card not recognised).
missing.transaction: Paid with Revolut: the Revolut transaction is not matched.
missing.amountChf: The CHF amount is unknown (foreign-currency receipt without a Revolut transaction).
missing.creditAccount: The payment account's bexio account (credit) is missing.

expenseDetail.readyToBook: All set: the receipt can be booked.
expenseDetail.bookedEntry: bexio entry no. {{id}} posted on {{date}}, receipt attached.
expenseDetail.bookedReconciliation: Marked booked on {{date}} (bank reconciliation in bexio).
expenseDetail.candidatesHint: Transactions ranked by score: the amount is mandatory; date, card and merchant break ties. Automatic matching from {{score}} points.
expenseDetail.bookDisabled: The receipt is not ready: see what is missing.
expenseDetail.unbookConfirm: The receipt goes back to be booked. Nothing changes in bexio.
expenseDetail.unbookConfirmEntry: The receipt goes back to be booked. Also delete entry no. {{id}} in bexio if it must go.
expenseDetail.ignoreHint: An ignored receipt leaves lists and totals; it can be restored at any time.
expenseDetail.ignoredHint: Ignored receipt: it counts neither in totals nor in the books.
